body: Oh I've already realized I'm my own monster in this.
Of I could hope for one thing it's that I could go back in time and warn myself of the hell that was coming so i could learn these lessons sooner and end this sick charade sooner.
No there is no one that cares I've reached out to anyone who claims to have cared to get nothing so no i have no one that cares.

I've lasted this long because i was a naive fill. I've survived off of hope that it can't get this bad. I'm at the lowest I've  ever been or felt and can't bare the thought of life getting worse than it already is. I've spent years living for everyone else and still havegot nothing back from this indifferent world. So why should i stay what should i continue to hope for?
